visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a 2D animation of a waitress in a red uniform holding a spatula and taking orders. A blue-haired animated boy appears in a circular logo in the top left. The background is pitch black with large white and light-blue text overlays. (2) An animated boy with blue hair and a grey t-shirt appears in the center, gesturing with a raised index finger. He has a cheerful facial expression. A red banner at the top contains white and yellow text. (3) A scene of real-world footage features a middle-aged man in a white business shirt and tie. He looks extremely stressed, holding his head while surrounded by chaotic stacks of paper in an office setting with cool lighting. (4) The animated boy returns, holding his chin in a thoughtful pose. Speech bubbles appear around him containing icons of half-finished reports and unread messages, accompanied by jagged lines representing psychological stress. (5) A graphic sequence shows the text 'Zeigarnik Effect' in a vibrant purple font. An animated icon of a yellow computer with a 'wait' message pops up, while the boy character holds a paper and looks towards the viewer. (6) A simple stick-figure animation of a professor in a black suit pointing at a chalkboard with letters. Two students are shown from behind, sitting at wooden desks in a minimalist classroom environment. (7) An animation of a restaurant scene unfolds where a waiter takes orders from a customer. A detailed list of menu items appears in Chinese, simulating a waiter's mental checklist against a dark background. (8) A pink cartoon brain character with expressive eyes is featured. A small orange fuzzy monster labeled 'unfinished' bothers the brain, causing it to turn red and show visible tension. The brain then packs items into a sack and tosses them away. (9) A round white creature with a purple speech bubble is shown. The scene cuts to a digital dashboard in a car with the text 'To be continued' appearing prominently on screen. (10) Real-world footage of a young woman with long dark hair and a friendly smile appears. She is wearing a school-style blazer and is set against a brightly lit, blurred indoor background. (11) The animated boy character returns, smiling and gesturing with both hands. The background is a mix of dark space and colorful text overlays as the video reaches its conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate the audience about the 'Zeigarnik Effect,' a psychological phenomenon where people remember uncompleted tasks better than completed ones. It uses relatable examples like restaurant orders and TV cliffhangers to explain the brain's tension mechanism.
